gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-m-plus-2: Bruno Ace SC spreads its open-mouthed letters out like beads on a long thread, expressive and unmistakable. And M PLUS 2 follows in a plain sans, drawn with one fixed nib width, so the heading gets the attention while the text just does its job.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-m-plus-code-latin: M PLUS Code Latin reads like neon tubing bent into letters, each c opening wide as a pitcher's mouth. And under Bruno Ace SC's beaded, spread-out display letters, a long stretch of it stays clean and approachable.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Wide-set, bold, a little futuristic. Bruno Ace SC strings out display letters with no thinning, while M PLUS Rounded 1c keeps its sans-serif terminals stopping short of curling back, which makes the two feel like distant cousins.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-mandali: Bruno Ace SC looks like a skeleton outline drawn at one thickness. Mandali, a plain sans with a generous entry into each e, makes a longer passage feel approachable and clean, never fussy.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-manjari: Spaced-out, open, unmistakably display. Manjari's sans-serif curves end in wide, unclosed terminals at a steady line weight, so a longer passage under Bruno Ace SC reads approachable and professional.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-meera-inimai: Bruno Ace SC is expressive and distinctive, its open letters spread out like beads on a long thread. Meera Inimai does the quieter work, with open-ended sans-serif curves that give a blueprint feel of constant line and room to breathe.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-metrophobic: Bruno Ace SC draws each spread-out letter with the flat line of a fineliner on paper, open and unhurried. Metrophobic handles the reading, its sans-serif curves running smooth and unobstructed.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-mina: Beaded letters, open and wide, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere in Bruno Ace SC. Mina follows in a plain sans, its strokes like a stitched thread outline, so a longer stretch of it reads contemporary and professional.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-moderustic: Expressive and distinctive, Bruno Ace SC holds a stroke at one width and spreads its open letters out like beads on a thread. Moderustic's sans curves, traced with a broad nib and left unfinished, read modern.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-molengo: One-nib letters, spread wide like beads on a thread, give Bruno Ace SC its expressive look. And Molengo, a sans with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, backs it up with contemporary, neutral text.
